row.evidence: Modern Treasury's docs say it "supports SCIM" for directory sync, but SCIM must be enabled by customer support; the pricing page has no plans, only "Let's talk about pricing for your use case."
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plan table; pricing is usage-based with annual terms and a minimum commitment, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. SCIM (Directory Sync) must be turned on by support, and SAML SSO is enabled by the CSM or support "if eligible". Setup runs through a hosted directory sync portal with per-IdP guides; synced users and groups are locked in the app and can only be changed or deleted from the IdP. No public non-SCIM user-management API was found in the Platform API reference.

plans.name: Custom contract (usage-based)
plans.price_text: Let's talk about pricing for your use case.
plans.notes: Single usage-based offering with annual terms and a minimum commitment; SSO and SCIM are enabled per organization by support.

auth.token_source: Organization settings > Directory Sync > Configure (hosted directory sync setup portal)

operations.notes: Docs say synced users and groups can only be updated or deleted through the IdP; PUT vs PATCH is not documented.

roles.how: IdP-pushed groups arrive as directory-synced groups; an admin assigns a Modern Treasury role to each group in the app.

limitations.text: SCIM must be enabled for the organization by Modern Treasury support before setup.
Once directory sync is on, group name, description and membership cannot be edited in the app, for synced or local groups.
Deleting or deprovisioning a group deletes approval rules that only that group could approve and removes it from notification groups.

user_api.notes: The Platform API rate limit (100 requests per second in Production, 20 per second for List endpoints) applies to the payments API; no user-management endpoints were found.

okta.notes: No OIN app found; the vendor's setup portal walks through adding SCIM to a custom Okta app integration.

fallbacks.notes: SAML 2.0 SSO is documented (enabled by CSM/support), but the docs do not say whether SSO creates accounts on first sign-in.

citations.title: Pricing | Modern Treasury
citations.quote: Yes. All platform and usage fees apply toward a single minimum commitment.

citations.title: System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM)
citations.quote: With SCIM, your identity provider is the source of truth for your organization’s user lifecycle management. Once you have directory sync set up, all user and group provisioning will be automatically managed through your identity provider.

citations.title: Connect Your Identity Provider
citations.quote: Users and groups managed by directory sync will have a new lock icon. These synced users and groups can only be updated or deleted through your identity provider.

citations.title: Manage groups with SCIM
citations.quote: Once SCIM and directory sync is configured for Modern Treasury, updates to group must be done in your identity provider. You will not be able to edit group name, description, or users for any groups (directory synced or local).

citations.title: Single Sign On (SSO)
citations.quote: Reach out to your CSM or Modern Treasury support to enable this feature, if eligible

citations.title: Roles and Permissions
citations.quote: A collection of users that are synced either via SCIM from an IDP or invited directly from the MT application. Groups must have at least 1 role assigned.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, version, token handling and supported attributes are only shown inside the hosted directory sync portal, not in public docs.
Docs do not say whether removing a user in the IdP deactivates or deletes the Modern Treasury user, frees a seat or ends sessions.
Which IdPs the setup portal lists beyond Okta is not documented publicly.
No public user-management (non-SCIM) API, audit-log API or user-event webhooks found in the Platform API reference.
Whether SSO and SCIM carry an extra charge inside the custom contract is not public.
